newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX May tests lower levels, but holds above $19.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX May tests lower levels, but holds above $19.

text.p: Brent May crude futures were testing lower levels in late afternoon trading on Wednesday but support at $19.00 per barrel was holding, brokers said.
May was last traded at $19.03, down eight cents from London's overnight settlement. The London market fell as low as $19.01, but found good support.
"The psychological $19.00 is a good number," one broker said, referring to support.
Brokers said there was a reluctance to extend short positions at current levels, offering little potential on the downside.
NYMEX May crude was last traded at $20.33, up five cents from New York, after reasonable ACCESS volume of 1,156 lots. However, most was traded during New York time.
Brokers said the API data overnight was neutral. A crude build of 6.42 million barrels was surprisingly big, but ex-PADD 5 was 1.38 million barrels and within the expected range.
